title: EnginePlugin
description: One plugin of the caller, of whichever engine has them (plan 13, B-27, B-47) — the engine's own routes say which one. `manifest` is `null` only when it can no longer be read at all — the directory moved, or the manifest stopped parsing.

commit.description: The commit a marketplace plugin is pinned at — `null` for a local one, which has none (plan 13, B-47).

state.description: `current`: the manifest reads the same as when approved. `changed`: it still reads, but differently — pending re-approval. `unreadable`: it can no longer be read at all. `marketplaceNotAllowed`: a marketplace plugin whose marketplace left the allowlist file (plan 13, B-47).
